# API Contract

The contract of all 49 API endpoints of IceFlow (Nhà máy đá tinh khiết Rubi), describing the API as it behaves today. The source of truth is `src/lib/contracts`; this file and `docs/openapi.json` are generated from it, and `npm run contract:verify` checks a running server against it.

## Conventions

- **Authentication**: the httpOnly cookie `auth_token`, or `Authorization: Bearer <JWT>`. Both carry the same 7-day JWT.
- **Success**: `{ "success": true, "data": … }` unless an endpoint says it has no envelope.
- **Errors**: `{ "success": false, "error": "<Vietnamese message>", "code"?: "<CODE>" }`. The role guards and the middleware send `{ "error", "code"? }` without `success`.
- **Password change required**: an account flagged `mustChangePassword` gets `403` with `code: "PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED"` on every endpoint outside `/api/auth/*`.
- **Dates**: timestamps are ISO 8601 strings; calendar dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`; months are `YYYY-MM`.
- **Money**: numbers, except where a field is marked "decimal as string".

## Auth

### POST `/api/auth/login`

Sign in with email and password.

- **Access**: Public
- **Contract id**: `login`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 429, 500
- **Notes**: Sets the httpOnly `auth_token` cookie (7 days) and also returns the JWT in `token` for non-browser clients. Rate limited to 5 attempts per IP per minute. The counter is keyed by the `x-real-ip` header and shared with `/api/auth/refresh`: without a proxy that sets `x-real-ip`, every client falls into one shared bucket.

Request body:

```ts
{
  email: string /* pattern */;
  password: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    user: {
      id: string;
      email: string;
      name: string;
      role: "ADMIN" | "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
      factoryId: string | null;
      mustChangePassword: boolean;
    };
    token: string;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/auth/logout`

Clear the session cookie.

- **Access**: Public
- **Contract id**: `logout`

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
  };
}
```

### GET `/api/auth/me`

Current user, or `user: null` when not signed in.

- **Access**: Public
- **Contract id**: `me`
- **Error statuses**: 403
- **Notes**: Never answers 401: an anonymous caller gets `{ user: null }`.

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    user: {
      id: string;
      email: string;
      name: string;
      role: "ADMIN" | "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
      factoryId: string;
      mustChangePassword: boolean;
    } | null;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/auth/refresh`

Exchange a still-valid session for a fresh 7-day JWT.

- **Access**: Any signed-in user
- **Contract id**: `refreshSession`
- **Error statuses**: 401, 429, 500
- **Notes**: Used by the mobile app. Rate limited to 30 per IP per minute, on the same counter as `/api/auth/login`, so refreshes also use up login attempts.

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    token: string;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/auth/password`

Change your own password.

- **Access**: Any signed-in user
- **Contract id**: `changePassword`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 429, 500
- **Notes**: New password: at least 8 characters, letters and digits, not a well-known password, different from the current one. Clears `mustChangePassword` and reissues the session cookie. Works even while a password change is required.

Request body:

```ts
{
  currentPassword: string;
  newPassword: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    token: string;
  };
}
```

## Factory

### GET `/api/factory`

Factory profile and shift self-registration limits.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `getFactory`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 500

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    factory: {
      name: string;
      phone: string | null;
      address: string | null;
      maxStaffPerShift: integer | null;
      maxDriversPerShift: integer | null;
    };
  };
}
```

### PATCH `/api/factory`

Update the factory profile.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `updateFactory`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: An empty `phone` or `address` is stored as null. A limit left out is unchanged; `null` removes it.

Request body:

```ts
{
  name: string;
  phone: string;
  address: string;
  maxStaffPerShift?: integer | null;
  maxDriversPerShift?: integer | null;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    factory: {
      name: string;
      phone: string | null;
      address: string | null;
      maxStaffPerShift: integer | null;
      maxDriversPerShift: integer | null;
    };
  };
}
```

## Customers

### GET `/api/customers`

Active customers, ordered by name.

- **Access**: ADMIN, STAFF
- **Contract id**: `listCustomers`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: With `countOnly=true` the data is `{ count }` instead of the list.

Query parameters:

```ts
{
  countOnly?: "true" | "false";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: Array<{
    id: string;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    address: string;
    phone: string;
    isActive: boolean;
    createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    factoryId: string;
  }> | {
    count: integer;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/customers`

Create a customer.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `createCustomer`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: The body is not schema-validated by the route: only `code` and `name` are checked for presence.

Request body:

```ts
{
  code: string;
  name: string;
  address?: string;
  phone?: string;
  isActive?: boolean;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    id: string;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    address: string;
    phone: string;
    isActive: boolean;
    createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    factoryId: string;
  };
}
```

### GET `/api/customers/debt-export`

Customers with debt ledger and shell deposit, plus their orders of the last 6 months.

- **Access**: Any signed-in user
- **Contract id**: `exportCustomerDebt`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 500
- **Notes**: Returned WITHOUT the `{ success, data }` envelope, and money fields are decimal strings. Any signed-in role can call it; the route does not check the role.

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  customers: Array<{
    id: string;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    address: string;
    phone: string;
    isActive: boolean;
    createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    factoryId: string;
    debtLedger: Array<{
      id: string;
      customerId: string;
      type: "DEBT" | "PAYMENT";
      amount: string /* decimal as string */;
      notes: string | null;
      createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    }>;
    shellDeposit: {
      id: string;
      customerId: string;
      shellsOut: integer;
      shellsIn: integer;
      depositPerShell: string /* decimal as string */;
      createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
      updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    } | null;
  }>;
  orders: Array<{
    id: string;
    customerId: string;
    status: "PENDING" | "SHIPPING" | "DELIVERED" | "COMPLETED" | "CANCELLED";
    notes: string | null;
    createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    driverId: string | null;
    assignerId: string | null;
    deliveredAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */ | null;
    factoryId: string;
    total: string /* decimal as string */;
    customer: {
      name: string;
    };
  }>;
}
```

## Inventory

### GET `/api/inventory`

Today's stock per active product.

- **Access**: Any signed-in user
- **Contract id**: `getInventory`
- **Error statuses**: 401, 500
- **Notes**: Any signed-in role can call it; the route does not check the role.

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    items: Array<{
      productId: string;
      productName: string;
      sizeKg: integer;
      unit: string;
      quantityOnHand: integer;
      totalKg: number;
    }>;
    totalBags: integer;
    totalKg: number;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/inventory`

Set or add to today's stock of a product.

- **Access**: Any signed-in user
- **Contract id**: `recordInventory`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 404, 500
- **Notes**: With `mode: "ADD"` the quantity is added to today's record; otherwise it replaces it. Any signed-in role can call it; the route does not check the role.

Request body:

```ts
{
  productId: string;
  quantity: number;
  mode?: "ADD";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    id: string;
    productId: string;
    date: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    quantityOnHand: integer;
  };
}
```

## Shell deposits

### GET `/api/deposits/shells`

Shell deposit balance of customers with deposit activity, highest owed first.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `listShellDeposits`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: Array<{
    customerId: string;
    customerName: string;
    shellsOut: integer;
    shellsIn: integer;
    depositPerShell: number;
    netDepositOwed: number;
  }>;
}
```

### PATCH `/api/deposits/shells`

Add shells handed out or returned to a customer's balance.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `updateShellDeposit`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 500
- **Notes**: The numbers are increments, and the response echoes the increments sent, not the new balance.

Request body:

```ts
{
  customerId: string;
  shellsOut?: integer;
  shellsIn?: integer;
  notes?: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
    customerId: string;
    shellsOut: integer;
    shellsIn: integer;
  };
}
```

## Orders

### GET `/api/orders`

Orders with customer, driver and items, newest first.

- **Access**: ADMIN, STAFF
- **Contract id**: `listOrders`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: An unknown `status` value is ignored rather than rejected. `date` filters on the creation day.

Query parameters:

```ts
{
  customerId?: string;
  status?: "PENDING" | "SHIPPING" | "DELIVERED" | "COMPLETED" | "CANCELLED";
  date?: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: Array<{
    id: string;
    customerId: string;
    status: "PENDING" | "SHIPPING" | "DELIVERED" | "COMPLETED" | "CANCELLED";
    notes: string | null;
    createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    driverId: string | null;
    assignerId: string | null;
    deliveredAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */ | null;
    factoryId: string;
    total: number;
    customer: {
      id: string;
      code: string;
      name: string;
      address: string;
      phone: string;
      isActive: boolean;
      createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
      updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
      factoryId: string;
    };
    orderItems: Array<{
      id: string;
      orderId: string;
      productId: string;
      quantity: integer;
      unitPrice: number;
      lineTotal: number;
      actualQty: integer | null;
      product: {
        id: string;
        name: string;
        sizeKg: integer;
        unit: string;
        isActive: boolean;
        createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
        updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
        factoryId: string;
      };
    }>;
    driver: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
    } | null;
  }>;
}
```

### PATCH `/api/orders/{id}/status`

Change an order status (not to COMPLETED).

- **Access**: ADMIN, STAFF
- **Contract id**: `updateOrderStatus`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 500
- **Notes**: `cancellationReason` is required when the status is CANCELLED and is stored in `notes`. COMPLETED is only reached through reconciliation. `total` comes back as a decimal string here.

Path parameters:

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

Request body:

```ts
{
  status: "PENDING" | "SHIPPING" | "DELIVERED" | "CANCELLED";
  cancellationReason?: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    id: string;
    customerId: string;
    status: "PENDING" | "SHIPPING" | "DELIVERED" | "COMPLETED" | "CANCELLED";
    notes: string | null;
    createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    driverId: string | null;
    assignerId: string | null;
    deliveredAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */ | null;
    factoryId: string;
    total: string /* decimal as string */;
  };
}
```

### PATCH `/api/orders/bulk-assign`

Assign several orders to a driver.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `bulkAssignOrders`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 500
- **Notes**: Only PENDING and SHIPPING orders are assigned; others are skipped and not counted.

Request body:

```ts
{
  orderIds: Array<string>;
  driverId: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
    assignedCount: integer;
    driver: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
    };
  };
}
```

### PATCH `/api/orders/{id}/confirm`

Driver confirms an order as delivered.

- **Access**: The assigned driver: a DRIVER session (cookie or Bearer JWT), or the driver share-link token sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` or as `token` in the body.
- **Contract id**: `confirmDelivery`
- **Error statuses**: 401, 403, 404, 500
- **Notes**: The body may be empty. Sets `deliveredAt`. No location is captured.

Path parameters:

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

Request body:

```ts
{
  token?: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
    orderId: string;
    status: "DELIVERED";
  };
}
```

### PATCH `/api/orders/{id}/reconcile`

Settle a delivered order: actual quantities, debt and stock.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `reconcileOrder`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: Only a DELIVERED order can be reconciled. A missing order or a wrong status is reported as 500 ("Đối soát thất bại"), not 404/409. Creates a DEBT ledger entry and deducts today's inventory.

Path parameters:

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

Request body:

```ts
{
  items: Array<{
    id: string;
    actualQty: integer;
  }>;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
    orderId: string;
    status: "COMPLETED";
  };
}
```

## Driver

### GET `/api/driver/orders`

A driver's SHIPPING and DELIVERED orders for one day.

- **Access**: A DRIVER session, or the driver share-link token in the `token` query parameter.
- **Contract id**: `listDriverOrders`
- **Error statuses**: 401, 403, 429, 500
- **Notes**: `date` defaults to today. Rate limited to 60 per IP per minute.

Query parameters:

```ts
{
  token?: string;
  date?: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    driver: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
    };
    orders: Array<{
      id: string;
      customerId: string;
      status: "PENDING" | "SHIPPING" | "DELIVERED" | "COMPLETED" | "CANCELLED";
      notes: string | null;
      createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
      updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
      driverId: string | null;
      assignerId: string | null;
      deliveredAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */ | null;
      factoryId: string;
      total: number;
      customer: {
        id: string;
        code: string;
        name: string;
        address: string;
        phone: string;
        isActive: boolean;
        createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
        updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
        factoryId: string;
      };
      orderItems: Array<{
        id: string;
        orderId: string;
        productId: string;
        quantity: integer;
        unitPrice: number;
        lineTotal: number;
        actualQty: integer | null;
        product: {
          id: string;
          name: string;
          sizeKg: integer;
          unit: string;
          isActive: boolean;
          createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
          updatedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
          factoryId: string;
        };
      }>;
      driverName: string;
    }>;
  };
}
```

### GET `/api/d/{token}`

Today's orders behind a driver share link.

- **Access**: The share-link token in the path; no session.
- **Contract id**: `getDriverLink`
- **Error statuses**: 404, 429, 500
- **Notes**: Returned WITHOUT the `{ success, data }` envelope; errors are `{ error }`. Rate limited to 30 per IP per minute.

Path parameters:

```ts
{
  token: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  driverName: string;
  orders: Array<{
    id: string;
    status: "SHIPPING" | "DELIVERED";
    total: number;
    customer: {
      id: string;
      code: string;
      name: string;
      address: string;
      phone: string;
    };
    orderItems: Array<{
      quantity: integer;
      product: {
        name: string;
        sizeKg: integer;
      };
    }>;
  }>;
}
```

## Accounts

### GET `/api/staff`

Every account of the factory, newest first.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `listStaff`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    users: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      email: string;
      role: "ADMIN" | "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
      isActive: boolean;
      createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    }>;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/staff`

Create a staff or driver account.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `createStaff`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 409, 500
- **Notes**: The new account must change its password at first login. A DRIVER also gets a driver profile and share link. Manager accounts cannot be created here. 409 when the email is taken.

Request body:

```ts
{
  name: string;
  email: string;
  password: string;
  role: "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    user: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      email: string;
      role: "ADMIN" | "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
      isActive: boolean;
      createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    };
  };
}
```

### PATCH `/api/staff/{id}`

Lock/unlock, rename, change role or reset the password of an account.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `updateStaff`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 500
- **Notes**: Only the fields sent are changed. A password reset forces a change at next login. You cannot edit yourself (400) or a manager account (403).

Path parameters:

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

Request body:

```ts
{
  isActive?: boolean;
  password?: string;
  role?: "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
  name?: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    user: {
      id: string;
      name: string;
      email: string;
      role: "ADMIN" | "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
      isActive: boolean;
      createdAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */;
    };
  };
}
```

### DELETE `/api/staff/{id}`

Deactivate an account (soft delete).

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `deactivateStaff`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 500

Path parameters:

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/staff/{id}/rotate-link`

Replace a driver's share link; the old link stops working.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `rotateDriverLink`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 500
- **Notes**: `link` is a relative path such as `/d/<token>`.

Path parameters:

```ts
{
  id: string;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    link: string;
    driverName: string;
  };
}
```

### GET `/api/drivers`

Active drivers with an active DRIVER account.

- **Access**: ADMIN, STAFF
- **Contract id**: `listDrivers`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: Includes each driver's share-link `token`.

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    phone: string | null;
    slug: string;
    token: string;
    isActive: boolean;
  }>;
}
```

### POST `/api/drivers`

Not supported: drivers are created as DRIVER accounts through POST /api/staff.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `createDriver`
- **Error statuses**: 401, 403, 405
- **Notes**: Always answers 405 for a manager.

## Schedule

### GET `/api/schedule/assignments`

Active staff and drivers with their shifts of one week.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `listScheduleAssignments`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 409, 500
- **Notes**: `week` is the first day of the 7-day window (the UI sends a Monday).

Query parameters:

```ts
{
  week: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    role: "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
    shifts: Array<{
      id: string;
      shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
      shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
      status: "PENDING" | "APPROVED" | "REJECTED";
    }>;
  }>;
}
```

### POST `/api/schedule/assignments`

Assign a shift to a person, or remove one.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `saveScheduleAssignment`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500
- **Notes**: A shift assigned by the manager is APPROVED. `shift: null` removes `removeShift`, or every shift of that day when `removeShift` is omitted. 409 `PAYROLL_LOCKED` when the month is closed. POST and PATCH behave the same.

Request body:

```ts
{
  userId: string;
  shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
  shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24" | null;
  removeShift?: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
    assignment: {
      id: string;
      userId: string;
      shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
      shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
      status: "APPROVED";
    } | {
      userId: string;
      shift: null;
      removeShift?: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
      shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
    };
  };
}
```

### PATCH `/api/schedule/assignments`

Assign a shift to a person, or remove one.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `saveScheduleAssignmentPatch`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500
- **Notes**: A shift assigned by the manager is APPROVED. `shift: null` removes `removeShift`, or every shift of that day when `removeShift` is omitted. 409 `PAYROLL_LOCKED` when the month is closed. POST and PATCH behave the same.

Request body:

```ts
{
  userId: string;
  shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
  shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24" | null;
  removeShift?: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
    assignment: {
      id: string;
      userId: string;
      shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
      shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
      status: "APPROVED";
    } | {
      userId: string;
      shift: null;
      removeShift?: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
      shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
    };
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/schedule/review`

Approve or reject shift requests.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `reviewShifts`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 409, 500
- **Notes**: 409 `PAYROLL_LOCKED` when any of the shifts is in a closed month.

Request body:

```ts
{
  ids: Array<string>;
  action: "APPROVE" | "REJECT";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    updated: integer;
  };
}
```

### GET `/api/schedule/my`

The team's week, with the caller's own requests.

- **Access**: STAFF, DRIVER
- **Contract id**: `getMySchedule`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: `today` and `currentHour` are Vietnam time. Other people's REJECTED requests are left out.

Query parameters:

```ts
{
  week: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    userId: string;
    today: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
    currentHour: integer;
    limits: {
      STAFF: integer | null;
      DRIVER: integer | null;
    };
    lockedMonths: Array<string /* YYYY-MM */>;
    people: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      role: "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
      shifts: Array<{
        shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
        shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
        status: "PENDING" | "APPROVED" | "REJECTED";
      }>;
    }>;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/schedule/my`

Request a shift for yourself.

- **Access**: STAFF, DRIVER
- **Contract id**: `requestMyShift`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 409, 500
- **Notes**: Created as PENDING. Repeating the request returns the existing shift unchanged; a REJECTED one becomes PENDING again. 400 for a past day or a slot of today that has ended; 409 `SHIFT_FULL` at the per-shift limit; 409 `PAYROLL_LOCKED`.

Request body:

```ts
{
  shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
  shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    shift: {
      shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
      shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
      status: "PENDING" | "APPROVED" | "REJECTED";
    };
  };
}
```

### DELETE `/api/schedule/my`

Withdraw your own pending or rejected request.

- **Access**: STAFF, DRIVER
- **Contract id**: `withdrawMyShift`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 409, 500
- **Notes**: 409 for an APPROVED shift (only the manager can change it) and for a closed month.

Request body:

```ts
{
  shiftDate: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
  shift: "SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24";
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    success: true;
  };
}
```

## Reports

### GET `/api/reports/shifts`

Approved shifts, hours and days per person for one month.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `getShiftReport`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: Only people with at least one shift in the month appear. `hours` = approved shifts × 3; `days` lists approved shifts only. `lockedAt` is set when the month is closed.

Query parameters:

```ts
{
  month: string /* YYYY-MM */;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    month: string /* YYYY-MM */;
    shiftHours: 3;
    lockedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */ | null;
    people: Array<{
      id: string;
      name: string;
      role: "ADMIN" | "STAFF" | "DRIVER";
      isActive: boolean;
      approvedShifts: integer;
      hours: integer;
      daysWorked: integer;
      pendingShifts: integer;
      rejectedShifts: integer;
      days: Array<{
        date: string /* YYYY-MM-DD */;
        shifts: Array<"SLOT_00_03" | "SLOT_03_06" | "SLOT_06_09" | "SLOT_09_12" | "SLOT_12_15" | "SLOT_15_18" | "SLOT_18_21" | "SLOT_21_24">;
      }>;
    }>;
  };
}
```

### POST `/api/reports/shifts/lock`

Close or reopen a payroll month.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `setPayrollLock`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 409, 500
- **Notes**: 409 `PENDING_SHIFTS` when closing a month that still has pending requests.

Request body:

```ts
{
  month: string /* YYYY-MM */;
  locked: boolean;
}
```

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: {
    month: string /* YYYY-MM */;
    lockedAt: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */ | null;
  };
}
```

### GET `/api/reports/debt`

Customers who owe money, highest debt first.

- **Access**: ADMIN
- **Contract id**: `getDebtReport`
- **Error statuses**: 400, 401, 403, 500
- **Notes**: Only customers with a positive balance are listed.

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  success: true;
  data: Array<{
    customerId: string;
    customerName: string;
    outstandingDebt: number;
    lastPaymentDate: string /* ISO 8601 timestamp */ | null;
  }>;
}
```

}

## System

### GET `/api/health`

Liveness and database check.

- **Access**: Public
- **Contract id**: `health`
- **Error statuses**: 503
- **Notes**: Returned WITHOUT the envelope. 503 with `{ ok: false, db: "down" }` when the database is unreachable.

Response `200`:

```ts
{
  ok: true;
  db: "up";
}
```
